Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He is utterly flabbergasted by whatever you just said.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Mon ami, are you ... how do you say, having a stroke ?

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: It is a stroke, oui ? When the brain of un animal is all wilted ?

Line.Text: Ah, I see. You are— Bah, you need to train more at home.
